name: Proximal Hamstring Tendinopathy
definition: Load-related tendinopathy at the proximal hamstring origin near the ischial tuberosity, common in running and prolonged sitting sports.

typical: Pain with running, hinging or prolonged sitting
Pain with resisted knee flexion or stretch

investigations.MRI: MRI/ultrasound is used for severe, refractory or suspected tear/avulsion.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs may detect bony avulsion in acute trauma.

amber: Injection/surgery is selective; acute major avulsion needs early orthopedic review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Snayu/Kandara Vata phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Load-related tendinopathy at the proximal hamstring origin near the ischial tuberosity, common in running and prolonged sitting sports.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
